name: phase_01_organization_invitations
lock_risk: Creates one initially empty Identity-owned invitation table and two bounded indexes without rewriting an existing product table.
representative_data: Runs against empty, previous-version, and deterministic Phase 01 identity lanes; live integration inserts concurrent idempotent invitation-issuance fixtures through the atlas_api role.
query_plan_review: The actor-and-idempotency unique key serializes response-loss retries, the verifier unique key supports a future constant-shape acceptance lookup, and tenant/status plus tenant/email indexes bound administrative and duplicate-recipient checks.
space_risk: Stores one hash-only verifier, one recipient digest, masked hint, authorization decision, and bounded metadata row per invitation; no recoverable token or full email is retained.
forward_fix: Disable invitation issuance and add a new ordered migration to correct grants, constraints, replay state, or future acceptance binding while preserving invitation and Audit history.
rollback: Disable invitation issuance before a forward fix; do not delete issued invitation facts, restore terminal invitations, recover secret material, or weaken delegation and Audit atomicity.
